description_en: Switches over the primary and secondary clusters in a global database network (GDN)
description_zh: 切换全球数据库网络（GDN）中的主从集群
kebab_example: aliyun polardb switch-over-global-database-network --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --gdn-id gdn-bp1fttxsrmv00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchOverGlobalDatabaseNetwork

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster that will become the primary cluster in the GDN.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264580.html operation to query the ID of the cluster in the GDN
parameters.help_zh:
GDN中需要切换为主集群的集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264580.html接口查看GDN中的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly switch over the primary and secondary clusters in the GDN. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制切换GDN的主从集群。取值范围：

true：表示强制切换GDN的主从集群。

false：表示不强制切换GDN的主从集群
parameters.name: forced

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
